verdict.rationale: Mercury supports card-level and team-level spend controls — 'curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions' (mercury-docs-10), programmatic spending-limit management via the Cards API (mercury-docs-36/52), and cashback/expense controls 'with cards, reimbursements, limits, and approvals' (mercury-docs-38) — which can approximate department/program budgets by issuing purpose-specific cards with individual limits (corroborated by a community user who created 'hundreds of virtual debit cards with individual limits' and 'dozens of purpose-named accounts', mercury-comm-1). However there's no evidence of a dedicated 'department/program budget' construct that aggregates spend across multiple cards/users against one enforced pool, only per-card/per-user limits and approval policies. Missing for 10: an explicit department- or program-level budget object with automatic aggregate enforcement across multiple cards/users, and independent verification of that specific feature beyond per-card limits.
